verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own guided flow for forming a company and registering an EIN. That flow implicitly produces formation filings, but it is in early beta, and there is no evidence of a general questionnaire-driven legal document template library or of flagging choices for attorney review. The 'not legal advice, works alongside your lawyer' disclaimer is not a review-flagging feature. Missing for 10: questionnaire-driven legal document generation beyond business formation, flagging of choices that need attorney review, accuracy or validation evidence, a GA (non-beta) release, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review

citations.quote: helping entrepreneurs form their company, register for an EIN, and open a business bank account in a single guided flow
Entrepreneurs can form their business directly through Gusto.
These capabilities are in early beta and will roll out to more entrepreneurs in the coming months.
